data.reason: T1 human sign-off — feature story for spotify-music-integration. The requirement set is complete and locked: 17 functional requirements (FR-SP-001..017, the stub->real-playback flip, both-provider search with Spotify preferred when linked and capable, explicit-YouTube unchanged, honest degradation for free-tier/unlinked/network-failure/empty-search, account linking by the caregiver, encrypted credential store and wipe-on-unlink) and 12 non-functional requirements (NFR-SP-001..012, latency budget, log safety, no new egress, prompt budget, localisation, no regression, encryption at rest, URI hardening, OAuth lifecycle, accessibility, compliance gates, plugin isolation), with 95 Gherkin acceptance scenarios. The owner is asked to approve the feature story before design work begins: confirm the scope and the Spotify-preferred preference semantics (constraint 9), the honest-degradation framing, and the acceptance of OD-S1/OD-S2/OD-S3 remaining open into design (OD-S2 is owner-involved: dev-mode rollout and quota-extension plan). Supersession note: the requirements.md Post-MVP placement of music playback is superseded by this feature (recorded in FR-SP-001 and the doc header).
